sentences.en: The rain had a good effect on the farm crops.
sentences.zh: 雨水对农田作物有很好的作用。

sentences.en: The medicine seemed to have no effect on the patient.
sentences.zh: 这种药似乎对病人没有效果。

sentences.en: I daresay your advice will have its effect on them.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定你的建议会对他们产生影响。

senses.zh: 结果，效果，效力，影响，要旨

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ef（出）+fect（做）→做出效果→效果

collocations.zh: 对 …… 有 影 响 / 作 用
